name: Ariza
description: The series tells an incredibly gripping story of a regular man and taxi driver named Ali Rıza, whose life changes forever upon encountering a breathtaking customer named Halide, the precious daughter of a known mob boss

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The house of taxi driver Ali Rıza Altay in the neighborhood of Kulaksız is hectic. Ali Rıza is marrying off his sister Nihan to his dear friend. Amid all this fuss, Ali Rıza continues to drive for bread money. On the other hand, Halide Gürkan attends the magnificent invitation given by Fuat Ersoylu on the occasion of his father Haşmet Gürkan's 70th birthday. During the invitation, Fuat Ersoylu's son Burak proposes to Halide, but Halide refuses. At the end of the discussion with Burak, Halide leaves the invitation and gets in the taxi of Rıza, who was there at that time. When Burak, who was after her, tries to get her out of the taxi, Ali Rıza intervenes and a fight breaks out. Burak takes the first slap of his life from Ali Rıza. Burak does not forget about this and then raids Rıza's sister's wedding. Halide also came to the wedding, guessing what will happen. But things get out of control. And after that night, nothing will ever be the same for either Ali Rıza or Halide.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Ali Rıza cannot pull the trigger after receiving a phone call, which revealed that his family was taken hostage by Fuat Ersoylu. Halide, the only name trusted by both sides, resolves the increasing tension between the two sides. Halide's support by appearing at unexpected times affects Ali Rıza. Moreover, Halide's sharing of her own losses with him causes a rapprochement between the two. Seeking a new way to hold an account of his sister's killers, Ali Rıza goes to Muzaffer. Muzaffer has a completely different offer for Ali Rıza. If he accepts this offer, Ali Rıza will go on an irreversible path. Halide, on the other hand, finds the necklace dragged from her neck by the murderers who murdered her family and pursues this clue, because whoever has that necklace has a finger in the massacre of her family. Ali Rıza takes action to deal a great blow to the city's biggest criminal organization.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: On the other hand, Fuat goes to Haşmet and claims that it is Haşmet's right-hand man Sabri who serves Burak's video on the internet and also gives his address, and he wants to take Sabri. Haşmet does not allow. The two old wolves face-off, drawing swords. Halide resigns from the hospital where she was working in Van. She will not leave his father alone and will be with him now. Ali Rıza's neutralization of Yaşar and dispersal of trucks makes a great repercussion in the criminal world. Burak takes action to regain his shaken reputation, and his target is Sabri. Everyone mobilizes to save Sabri from Burak's hand. Unexpected events bring Burak, Halide and Ali Rıza together at the same point. Now is the time for reckoning for Ali Rıza and Burak.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: While Ali Rıza and Burak challenge each other, the news comes that Haşmet and Murat are in safety upon the complaint of Lawyer Füsun. The members of the consortium gather and express their discomfort when Sabri is taken by Burak. Haşmet wants to get closer to Rıza, who saved Sabri. His aim is to learn who is behind Rıza. When he comes to the stop to thank Rıza, the stall is attacked by the Yaşar people and the mess gets mixed up.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Hasmet asks Ali Riza all the questions that are on his mind. With his answers, Ali Riza gains Hasmet's trust and becomes his right-hand man. Hasmet tells Riza to enter the consortium in order to destroy it from within and to shake hands with the Ersoy family. Hasmet, who puts pressure on Fuat, says that Ali Riza is now his right-hand man and that they should act together and with peace. Hasmet, who surprisingly attended the consortium meeting, surprises everyone with his decision. In the face of Hasmet's unexpected move, Fuat takes action to seek support for himself. Halide, who follows the traces of the past, goes after "Sadi Aksoy", but Halide is not the only one who goes after Sadi Aksoy. Ali Riza is also after Sadi for a very different reason. However, a great surprise which includes Muzaffer awaits Ali Riza.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After what Halide said, everyone in the family waits for an answer from Ali Rıza. Unable to tell the truth, Ali Rıza says that he did everything for Nihan's revenge. Rukiye then tells Ali Rıza not to come to their family home again until he returns to the old Ali Rıza. Halide, on the other hand, begins to track down a man named Behçet, a key person who will enlighten the secrets of the past. When the consortium comes together, a decision on what punishment Galip will give to Ali Rıza is made, while Burak's actions come to light. Thereupon, Galip forgives the two young people in exchange for their work together. The new task of the duo is to deliver Salman as soon as possible. When the day of duty arrives, a surprise designed by Burak awaits Haşmet and Ali Rıza.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Burak surprises Ali Rıza and Haşmet, who are in a difficult position in front of Salman, with what he did. Ali Rıza, on the other hand, sees Burak as responsible for the unsuccessful shipment. Ali Rıza first goes after how Burak stole the weapons from the warehouse. Burak draws attention with his promises at the consortium meeting and Burak has a chance to have a seat in the consortium. On the other hand, Ali Rıza goes after the guns Burak hides and finally reaches the guns. But Burak also has a cruel surprise he prepared for Ali Rıza.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Ali Riza, with the help of Ferit and Hasan, comes out of the rubble and comes to his senses. What Ali Riza wants to do as soon as possible is to kill Burak, but Haşmet will prevent it. Because now they have a much bigger problem. Halide, on the other hand, is accepted by an international aid organization to which she applied to be a doctor abroad. Haşmet, on the other hand, undertakes a difficult task to protect his daughter and the family of everyone in the consortium. Ali Rıza, on the other hand, is obliged to do what Haşmet says in this task. At the end of the mission, a mutual surprise awaits Ali Rıza and Haşmet.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Cabir presses the remote, but the bomb doesn't explode. In the conflict, Huzeyfe becomes the target of Ali Rıza's bullets. Cabir has his eyes set on Ali Rıza, who killed his brother, and says that he will not kill him without seeing him suffer first. Ali Rıza's family, on the other hand, decides to settle in Haşmet's house until the trouble is over. When Cabir threatens everyone in the consortium with their loved ones, Ali Rıza goes to Cabir and surrenders. Cabir, on the other hand, is not satisfied with this, and he has set his mind to harm both Ali Rıza and his loved ones.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Ali Riza brings Mert, who was shot by Cabir, to the hospital. Mert is taken into surgery. When Cabir learns that Mert survived the surgery, he comes to the hospital with his men and is then caught by Ali Riza and Muzaffer. Ali Riza tells Muzaffer that he is not finished with Cabir and that he can bring the consortium to his knees and explains his plan. Everyone in the consortium is attacked by Cabir and the consortium starts to crack, until the end of the day, until Ali Riza, Murat and Derya are saved and shot Cabir. Burak is now out of the game and is expelled from the consortium.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Fuat organizes a great night in honor of Ali Riza. Important names of the underworld show up on this night. The news that Sehmuz announces casts a shadow on the night. As Burak is out of the consortium, he finds a new business partner. Halide, on the other hand, is excited about the clinic that she will open, but Hasmet is not happy with this situation. Ali Riza accepts his first duty in his new office, but falls victim to Burak and his new partner Numan, and confronts Sehmuz.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Ali Rıza explains in the consortium why Şehmuz burned his goods. Although Fuat seems to be convinced of this statement, the truth is that he is not. He instructs Rıfkı and asks Ali Rıza to investigate. Halide makes everyone very happy by naming her new polyclinic after Nihan. Burak lays the foundations for a new partnership that will rival the consortium and chooses Ali Rıza as the first victim. Surprisingly, Hasan learns from Haşmet about Ali Rıza's secret mission. Ali Rıza stands in front of Haşmet and says that he and Halide love each other.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: While Haşmet and Ali Rıza are making a showdown, Halide does not understand why her father is so angry. Haşmet goes to Fuat and wants to decipher Ali Rıza's secret mission, and Muzaffer, who learns this, orders Haşmet's execution without hesitation. Learning about Muzaffer from cook İsmail, Fuat visits Muzaffer at his place. Burak, on the other hand, is trying to attract close men of the consortium members to his ranks with his partners. While trying to protect Yavuz, one of Haşmet's special men, Ali Rıza finds himself in pursuit of Numan. Ali Rıza, who caught Numan, was kidnapped by a special team with a sack on his head in the forest.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Ali Rıza opens his eyes and tries to recuperate after all kinds of torture. Muzaffer still has not been able to find out who is behind this job. Ali Rıza details what happened to him at the consortium meeting, but says he does not know who did it, and Fuat explains who did this job. Halide is shocked by what she heard from Ali Rıza; She says to Ali Rıza, "We cannot be". When Ali Rıza destroys Numan's warehouse, Numan asks Burak for money. Melek has now made her decision, she will share the great secret she learned with Haşmet. When the money sent by Burak turns out to be fake, Numan comes to Burak's house and opens fire. The target of the bullets is Halide, not Burak.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Ali Rıza hurriedly rushes Halide to the hospital. Haşmet, who received the news, says that if something happens to his daughter, he will not keep anyone alive. Burak wants to reach Numan before Ali Rıza, but he cannot be successful because Ali Rıza captured Numan and killed him. Unable to get any news from his son, Fuat gathers the consortium and says that Haşmet and Ali Rıza may have killed his son. Ali Rıza comes to the meeting and throws Burak in front of Fuat because Burak confessed everything he did. Thereupon, the consortium condemns Burak to death. Fuat makes a plan to save his son from this death, but surprisingly, Ali Rıza is included in the plan.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: While Burak thought that he will get away with his father's plan to save him, he found Ali Riza in front of him. This time Ali Riza will take revenge on Burak and kill him. However, when Murat confronts Hasmet to save his brother and makes a new agreement, Ali Riza's plan to kill Burak falls apart. Hasmet and Halide learn important information about who the murderer of their families is, and they experience great pain after learning it. This pain ignites a new war for Hasmet, now Fuat Ersoylu is on the target.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: After being shot by Halide, Fuat is taken under an operation and then under observation, without being notified of his critical condition. Haşmet, who learns that Halide is in Burak's hand, finds his last resort before the old man. While Ali Rıza is trying to reach Halide from four directions; Burak does not stop in his father's absence and attacks everyone who is not on his side. One of the targets of these attacks is the taxi stand. Mithat and Melek continue to make new plans after what happened to them. Confronting Burak, Ali Rıza does not hesitate to put forward his own life to save Halide.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Hashmet, sticking to his agreement with the Old Man, declares a ceasefire for now.  Halide experiences the joy of having Ali Riza, who put his life on the line to save her. Ali Riza goes after Ahmad and Erol for revenge.  Fatih is sent on his final journey in tears with a ceremony attended by everyone.  The decisions made by the Old Man for the new term mark the consortium meeting.  Now all balances are turned upside down.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Haşmet confronts Fuat and begins to ask for the account of his brutal betrayal in the past, but Fuat is not easily undone. Burak, who is willing to do anything to get to his father, finds Murat, the name at the head of the family. Murat risked facing his brother because he did not want to break the deal. Muzaffer, on the other hand, has a request from Ali Riza, and if he does not fulfill this request, Muzaffer threatened him with his most precious. Muzaffer has a great trump card that will give away Khalid and Haşmet. Ali Riza makes a plan to pay the price so that his loved ones do not get hurt.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Fuat Ersoylu is buried in a simple ceremony at Burak’s request.  The Old Man’s right-hand man, Safir, contacts Ali Riza and gives him his first duty.  Burak goes after the name his father told him before he died.  Halide is excited about a little holiday she has dreamed of for a long time where she and Ali Riza can rest their heads.  After many years of triumphant life, someone reminds Ms. Rukiya of a fact.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Burak is very disappointed to learn that his brother betrayed his father.  Ali Riza has now met with the Old Man and promises that he will find Balaban.  While Ali Riza is searching for Balaban, he shows up for an unpleasant visit to Halide's clinic.  The members of the consortium convened under the leadership of the Old Man decide what to do in the new term.  Burak and Balaban have founded the foundations of new cooperation.  Ali Riza, who learns something new about his father every day, gets more and more confused.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Balaban is against Safir, but he doesn't intend to talk.  Rukiya, on the other hand, has been without reining in her fears since she spoke to Muzaffar.  Balaban, who was surprised to be abducted from the Old Man, wants to make a deal with Ali Riza.  Burak, on the other hand, has already made a new deal with Balaban and is on the job.  Halide and Ali Riza make an important decision on their future.  Burak, who thinks he is melting the ice with his brother, is unaware of the surprise that awaits him as he leaves his brother in a difficult situation with his plan.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Ali Riza tries to find out where Halide is by calling Balaban, but Balaban says he did not kidnap Halide himself.  The Old Man thinks Balaban is behind this and orders Burak to bring Balaban to her. Halide hears from Balaban who confronts her at the place of her imprisonment that she has not heard about her family's death and is shocked. The Old Man sits Balaban across from her, but she doesn't intend to give him a seat at the table for the time being until she witnesses the surprise that awaits Ali Riza and Halide.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: The Old Man accepts Balaban's conditions and a new era begins in the consortium.  Ali Riza decides not to let Balaban go after what happened to Halide.  When the consortium convenes, Ali Riza shocks everyone with his actions. Ali Riza and his family are confronted with an unexpected situation at Haşmet's house when they go to ask for Halide's hand in marriage. Ali Riza takes everything and goes after an ex-cop to get the facts about his father.  Meanwhile, the consortium will leave Ali Riza out of the game with its decision.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Ali Riza, who defeated his formidable opponent, by reaching out to Selim learns new information about Balaban's family and his own father.  The alliance formed by Mithat, Balaban, Burak, and Murat aims to bring Haşmet and Ali Riza to their knees by making a new plan.  Knowing that Haşmet was offended by Ali Riza, the Ihtiyar confronts Haşmet and reveals her great secret and says, 'Ali Riza is my son!' Ali Riza and Mert go with Halide to their father's burial site to track down their father.  They'll be faced with something they didn't expect in the cemetery.‎

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: ‎Everyone's eyes and ears are on the news about Haşmet and Mert who are in the hospital.  After all this, the Ihtiyar removes Mithat from the head of the consortium and abolishes the table.  While everyone chooses their side and sets out their plan, Ali Riza storms Mithat's secret meeting with an old friend. Balaban then wants to leave his adversaries to death by making a new plan.  Ali Riza, on the other hand, is shocked by a surprise phone call.‎

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: After the attack at Haşmet's house, he asks Mithat to capture Burak and hand him over to him.  Burak and Balaban always attribute Ali Riza to a spy within them. Melek reveals the great secret by confronting Haşmet with "Murat and Burak were the shooters who murdered your family." Aslan reaches an address thanks to signals from Ali Riza's father's phone.  However, when they arrive at the address, it gets messy as they encounter a bitter surprise.‎

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Ali Riza brings his wounded father home, and years later, the household who see Mehmet Emin in front of them is confused as to what to do. When Haşmet asks Murat about the past, Murat attempts something that is not in the account.  Rukiya, on the other hand, gathers her courage and explains the truth to Ali Riza. The Ihtiyar strengthens Burak's power by making a surprise decision after what Ali Riza tells her.  Balaban is unaware of what will happen to him as he contemplates preparing the end of Haşmet and Ali Riza thanks to his new plan.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Ali Reza took revenge on Balaban, and now it's Burak's turn.  Burak, on the other hand, is desperate to get the power to stay with the Ihtiyar who has a few days left, and on the other hand, plans to finish Ali Riza and Haşmet which leaves Halide with a dilemma that requires her to choose between her father and Ali Riza. Ali Riza and Haşmet, on the other hand, on their way to prevent Burak's power decide it's about pulling people down the street and take action. Ali Riza goes after number 7, who is mentioned in the notebook left by his father and is one of the Shadows, but he does not need to look far away because number 7 is no stranger to Ali Riza...

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Ali Riza faces Muzaffer, who he has known as a friend all this time. Burak, on the other hand, is disappointed not to have the power he dreamed of because of the raid they suffered.  In addition to the losses they suffered, his companion Fiko was also seriously injured in this raid.  Burak and Muzaffer find a way to trace the money stolen from the warehouse. While Haşmet and Ali Riza are planning to end this war once and for all, Halide worries that something will happen to them.  Moreover, Halide has very important news to tell Ali Riza.  As the weapons are armed for this last battle, Ali Riza will learn that he has another reason to live.
